backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no methods or logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a header branding image size increase and mapping it to affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for all frontend source files, describing styling, components, content, and configuration.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide outlining build prerequisites, common errors, and steps for successful production deployment.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens, light/dark theme variables, and global element styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component that assembles the header, page sections, and footer into the full layout.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Client‑side validated contact form with inline errors, submit simulation, and success/error messaging.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: About section showing title, mission text, and three core values with icons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Renders a contact section with email, address, phone links, and a contact form using marketing copy content.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Displays the hero banner with headline, subheadline, background image, and CTA buttons that scroll to sections.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a grid of service cards using marketing content and mapped icons for each service.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with brand text, navigation shortcuts, social links, and a credits bar.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Sticky responsive header with enlarged logo, scroll‑to‑section navigation, and mobile menu behavior.
frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts: Exports centralized paths for logo assets in multiple sizes.
frontend/src/content/marketingCopy.ts: Defines static marketing text for hero, about, services, and contact sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, invalidating queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, logout, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future backend-related queries using the actor hook.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes with agriculture-focused colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: Provides Vite type definitions for the project.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, custom OKLCH color tokens, extended fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animation.
frontend/tsconfig.node.json: TypeScript config for Vite’s Node-side setup, enabling composite builds, ESNext modules, bundler resolution, and including vite.config.ts.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Defines Vite config with React plugin, path alias for src, build output settings, and a dev server on port 3000.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, feature descriptions, and versioned state for a React + Vite marketing site with ICP scaffolding.
